comparison_baseline.rationale: This skill is a python_adapter port of the original claude_code evolutionary search skill. The baseline is the original skill (improving-existing-skill pattern), to measure whether dropping Claude-in-the-loop steering changes output quality at small eval scale.

evals.name: narrow-gap-stable
evals.prompt: 用 skills/materials/evaluation/high_mobility/cif_for_evolving/ 目录下的全部 8 个 CIF 作为初始种子池，做进化搜索。目标：找热力学稳定（ehull minimize）且带隙落在 [0.1, 1.5] eV 的窄带半导体。约束：bandgap [0.1, 1.5] eV weight=10（hard），禁用 Pb。规模：pop_size=10, max_generations=3, noise_level=0.3, crossover_rate=0.0。返回最终 Pareto 前沿 + leaderboard.csv。
evals.expected_output: Final Pareto front (pareto/*.cif) + leaderboard.csv. Both versions should run init->3 steps->finalize. Quality bar: at least one candidate with bandgap in [0.1, 1.5] and the lowest ehull on the front.

evals.name: high-dielectric-stable
evals.prompt: 用 skills/materials/evaluation/high_mobility/cif_for_evolving/ 目录下的全部 8 个 CIF 作为初始种子池，做进化搜索。目标：找热力学稳定（ehull minimize）且高介电（dielectric maximize）的候选。约束：禁用 Pb。规模：pop_size=10, max_generations=3, noise_level=0.3, crossover_rate=0.0。返回最终 Pareto 前沿 + leaderboard.csv。
evals.expected_output: Final Pareto front + leaderboard.csv. Quality bar: the candidate with the highest dielectric on the front should be > the best seed's dielectric (search must improve, not just echo seeds).

assertions.name: init_completed
assertions.description: Phase 1 init succeeded (run_dir/population.json exists, generation 0 snapshot present)

assertions.name: all_generations_run
assertions.description: Exactly max_generations step calls ran (snapshots gen1..gen{max_generations} all present)

assertions.name: finalize_completed
assertions.description: leaderboard.csv exists and has >=1 row; pareto/ dir has >=1 CIF

assertions.name: pareto_front_nonempty
assertions.description: At least 1 CIF in pareto/ with formula != seed formula (true evolution happened)

assertions.name: best_ehull_improved_or_held
assertions.description: Best ehull on final front <= best ehull in gen0 (search did not regress)

assertions.name: diversity_unique_formulas
assertions.description: >=3 unique reduced formulas across the final population

assertions.name: no_hard_constraint_violation_on_front
assertions.description: For narrow-gap eval: all front candidates have bandgap within [0.1, 1.5] OR viol=0 in leaderboard
